title: On Sharpest Tail Bounds for Functions of Tail Bounded Random Variables
summary: Consider $n$ real/complex, independent/dependent random variables with respective tail bounds and $g$ a measurable function of the r.v.'s. Consider $f$ the "sharpest" tail bound of $g$ (sharpest in the sense that if $f$ were any less, then for some $X_1,...,X_n$ satisfying the conditions, $g(X_1,...,X_n)$ would not satisfy $f$). Significant research has been done to approximate $f$ often with high accuracy.
